manual_notes: PR1168 delivers substantive animation code: validators, React lifecycle logic/tests, native manager/session and bridge wiring. Reviewed validator ranges, native play/pause/cancel/snapshot/loop code and lifecycle/error test definitions. This long specification also requires precise untargeted-field coexistence, shortest-path rotation and all asynchronous failure/unmount orderings; these end-to-end guarantees were not fully traced. Strict completion remains unconfirmed; no missing implementation or abandonment inferred.
rationale: Substantial implementation is corroborated but full acceptance coverage of this broad multi-layer specification is beyond the demonstrated evidence. The narrower runtime-capability sibling has its own decision.

sources.observed_facts: animationValidator.ts validates targets/timing/loop/playbackRate; native EntityAnimationManager snapshots from state, manages pause/resume/cancel and RealityKit loops/completion. Added lifecycle/features tests target serialization, replacement failure, state flags and callback timing. Review does not establish every native acceptance guarantee.

limitations: Static review only; no tests were executed or deployed behavior independently verified.
review_depth: Read full 400+line specification and task/history packet; inspected complete animationValidator and native manager diff, capability implementation, and lifecycle/features test definitions. Did not fully trace every React/native guarantee or execute tests.
